wargear.name: Laurels of Perfection
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A circlet of gold leaf awarded for a flawless victory, and worn as though the next one were already won. The model gains +1 Cool and +1 Initiative.

wargear.name: Banner of Dissonance
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A standard strung with tuned bells and wire that howl in the wind of the charge. The unit gains Fear (1).

wargear.name: Narcotic stimulants
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cocktail of synaptic boosters that turns pain into pleasure and orders into noise. The unit gains Feel No Pain (6+) and every model suffers -1 Willpower.

rites.name: The Flawless Host
rites.flavor: To the Third, a victory with a single flaw in it is a defeat in good clothes.
rites.text: Palatine Blade squads, Phoenix Terminator Squads and Veteran Tactical and Veteran Assault Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1). Palatine Blade and Phoenix squads gain +1 Weapon Skill. No common soldier is allowed to spoil the picture: no Tactical, Despoiler, Assault, Breacher, Scout or Inductii Squads. At least one Palatine Blade squad is required.

require.note: Bring at least one Palatine Blade squad.

rites.name: Symphony of Slaughter
rites.flavor: The battle is only the percussion. The screaming is the melody.
rites.text: Kakophoni Squads may fill Troops slots, cost 40 points less and gain Fear (1). Every Infantry unit in the army suffers -1 Intelligence from the din. The orchestra needs quiet ears to conduct: no Recon units. At least two Kakophoni Squads are required.

require.note: Bring at least two Kakophoni Squads.

rites.name: Descent of the Gilded Wings
rites.flavor: They fall like fireworks and are gone before anyone thinks to look away.
rites.text: Palatine Blade Aquilae squads, Veteran Assault Squads and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots. Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains +1 Movement. Nothing earthbound can match the tempo: no Heavy sub-type units, no Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.

modifiers.text: Descent of the Gilded Wings: +1 M.

rites.name: A Thousand Suns
rites.flavor: Each shot is composed. Each corpse is arranged. Nothing is left to chance but the applause.
rites.text: Sun Killer Squads may fill Troops slots, cost 15 points less and gain Line (1) and +1 Ballistic Skill. The gunnery is an art of its own, and has no patience for support weapons: no Heavy Support, Tactical Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads, no Rapier or Tarantula Batteries, and no more than one Armour unit. At least two Sun Killer Squads are required.

require.note: Bring at least two Sun Killer Squads.
